newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian T-bills open mixed, eye on data, election.
newsitem.headline: Canadian T-bills open mixed, eye on data, election.

text.p: Canadian T-bills opened little changed in quiet trade on Monday, with investors looking ahead to economic data out this morning and the results of today's federal election in Canada, analysts said.

"I don't see a lot of activity. It's probably going to be quietish day as people just see where we go. I think it's probably priced in somewhat the market is expecting a Liberal majority," said one T-bill dealer with a one bank-owned brokerage.
Canada's three-month when-issued T-bill traded unchanged from Friday's close to yield 3.01 percent.
